meta_state_law_citations_007.answer:
Should impasse occur during negotiations, the impasse procedure in Chapter 447, Florida Statutes, shall apply.

The Association as bargaining agent shall be granted all rights and privileges as set forth in the Statement of Recognition by PERC and the Public Employee Relations Act, Florida Statues 447.

Any medical expenses incurred by a teacher for physical examinations, inoculations, and tests that may be required by the School Board and not required by State Statutes shall be borne by the Board.

The Board agrees to provide professional development opportunities through the Professional Development Department and operate it within the provisions of Florida Statutes.

In addition, the Board shall provide the Association access to all public records not exempted by Florida Statutes within one working day of such request.

Nothing contained herein shall be construed to deny or restrict to any teacher rights under Florida School Laws or other applicable laws and regulations.

Any involvement of the School Board in the private or personal life of the teacher shall remain within the scope of the Florida Statutes.

All files maintained on teachers shall be confidential except as provided in School Board rules or Florida Statutes.

Such files shall be open to inspection only in accordance with Florida Statutes.

Student meetings mandated by statute will be scheduled based on the instructor’s calendar(s).
